name: Flashcard Generator
description: Flashcard generator. Convert study material or text into interactive study decks.

howToUse:
1. Upload your study material or type your topic.
2. Select the desired number of cards.
3. Click 'START' to generate your deck.
4. Click on the cards to flip them and test your memory.
features:
• Info Extraction
• Interactive Flip UI
• Multi-format Support
